editorial: Hold onto the feeling that two souls are tethered by an invisible thread that twists through innocence and heartbreak. Soulmate injects a raw, unscripted rhythm, letting Mi‑so and Ha‑eun’s dialogue breathe with every breath of the story. The long‑take, hand‑held camera work gives the film an uncanny authenticity that lingers long after the credits. Though the third act stretches, the emotional payoff steadies the journey. You will find resonance if you cherish stories that chase friendship’s fragile evolution toward love.
targetAudience: Ideal for viewers seeking deeply personal dramas that unfold with patience and emotional honesty.
